name: song Mini replaces saved Mini at runtime
lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
local function near(value, expected)
    assert(math.abs(value - expected) < 0.000001, tostring(value) .. ' != ' .. tostring(expected))
end
po('Preferred', 'SetPlayerOptions', 'M730, 60% Mini')
po('Song', 'Mini', 0.6, 10000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.016)
near(po('Song', 'Mini'), 0.6)
near(po('Current', 'Mini'), 0.6)
-- The same setter is used by 7th Gear's bigMini easing callbacks.
po('Song', 'Mini', 0.32, 10000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.032)
near(po('Current', 'Mini'), 0.32)
po('Song', 'Mini', 0.6, 10000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.048)
near(po('Current', 'Mini'), 0.6)
-- FromString and direct Current writes also assign absolute values.
po('Song', 'FromString', '*10000 -100% Mini')
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.064)
near(po('Current', 'Mini'), -1)
po('Current', 'Mini', 0.6)
near(po('Current', 'Mini'), 0.6)
near(po('Preferred', 'Mini'), 0.6)
